'''Guumak''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] regular of [[The Drunken Ootak]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Vinsoth/Legends|Vinsoth]]. In [[44 ABY]], he engaged in a drinking game with [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Madhi Vaandt]], to whom he lost his [[Chev]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]], [[Shohta Laar]].
